_comment: ONE list of the ERP modules too consequential to ship unwatched, shared by Oneshot and the Plane triage router (triage-cron reads this file via ONESHOT_HOME). Oneshot uses `paths`: a plan or diff touching one arms the review gates (highScrutinyPaths is derived from this file in src/lib/config.ts). Triage uses `keywords`: a Plane ticket whose text names one is routed to the human erp board, never the AI board. Add a module here and both sides pick it up.
_comment_coupled: No separate coupled-pair list: every linked pair in the ERP's CLAUDE.md table (payroll↔leaves, payroll↔costing, costing↔invoices, allowances↔payroll, leaves↔costing, payroll↔odoo) has at least one side in `modules`, so the module keywords already route it to the human board. Add a pair list only if a pair appears with neither side here.
_comment_external: Integrations Oneshot's local verify phase cannot exercise: no sandbox, real third-party state, or timing it cannot drive. A ticket whose behaviour lives here would 'pass' verify without anything being tested, so triage routes it to the human board.
